name: dsh-supreme
description: Seven host-side policy plugins for DeepSeek Harness, composed through DSH's vendored Cordis runtime. Installable as a dsh bundle: dsh plugin --profile <name> add <this package>. Pinned upstream: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness @ d347e703908d0406b7a7ef80e3a0e594d86b2215.

scripts.build:upstream: DSH_REPO="${DSH_UPSTREAM_ROOT:-}"; [ -n "$DSH_REPO" ] || DSH_REPO="$(pwd)/../deepseek-harness"; [ -d "$DSH_REPO" ] || DSH_REPO="$(pwd)/node_modules/.upstream/deepseek-harness"; SUPREME_ROOT="$(pwd)"; "$SUPREME_ROOT/real/build-batched.sh" host "$DSH_REPO/tsconfig.host.json" "$DSH_REPO" && cd "$DSH_REPO" && npx tsdown --config-loader tsx --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE host && "$SUPREME_ROOT/real/build-batched.sh" client "$DSH_REPO/tsconfig.client.json" "$DSH_REPO" && npx tsdown --config-loader tsx --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE client
scripts.v13:verify: bun real/v13-policy-verify.mjs && bun real/v13-workflow-verify.mjs && bun real/v13-routing-verify.mjs
